plainTranslation: Composite Uranus in the 2 House: With Composite Uranus in the 2nd house, there can be some instability when it comes to your finances and resources together. In a personal relationship, you need to make sure you’re saving and being responsible, otherwise you may find you’re not in a good position all of the time. In a business relationship, this can be an excellent position for a business partnership that makes money in bursts, by commission, or in a sporadic way, as well as one focused on technology or the internet.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
note: Imported from The Dark Pixie Astrology composites material text.
